desc: Build adjacency list from edges and set up iterative DFS (or recursive with `sys.setrecursionlimit`).
Implement the unique‑value sliding window during DFS: maintain `value_to_idx` map and stack of nodes on the current valid segment; pop nodes when duplicate value is encountered.
Track the answer: compute current segment length and node count, update global max length and min node count with tie‑breaking.
Test on provided examples (mentally verified) – expected `[6,2]` and `[0,1]`.
Fix duplicate‑value handling bug: after popping nodes, unconditionally remove their values from `value_to_idx` (or correctly adjust the map) so that the map always reflects the current stack state.
Verify edge cases: single node paths (length 0, nodes 1), all values identical (`[0,1]`), deep chain (recursion limit or iterative DFS).
Run additional stress tests: random trees with N up to 5·10⁴ to confirm correctness and performance.
Complexities and finalization: Confirm O(N) time / O(N) space, produce final `return [best_len, best_nodes]`.
Consider edge case where the root itself has a duplicate value with a descendant (should correctly reset stack to just the current node).
